1. Protect privacy and individual evidence

WHERE YOU ARE

At your own workstation before opening any project.

WHAT TO FIND

The privacy notice in this guide.

EXACT ACTION

Confirm that every input is synthetic and that no credential, token, cookie, Moodle record, private repository or personal dataset will enter screenshots, Gemini or GitHub.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

You can name the exact synthetic fixture and your private PDF destination.

WHAT TO RECORD

A one-sentence privacy declaration in the form.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

You can continue without exposing another person or an institutional secret.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Use the offline synthetic route and record the blocker.

STOP CONDITION

Any required evidence would expose protected data.

CONTINUE WITH

Step 2 — extract the ZIP.

2. Extract the complete ZIP

WHERE YOU ARE

File Explorer, Finder or your Linux file manager.

WHAT TO FIND

The downloaded S03 ZIP and an Extract action.

EXACT ACTION

Keep the ZIP intact, extract it into a new short writable folder and wait for completion.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

A normal folder containing 00_START_HERE, 02_PROJECTS and root launchers.

WHAT TO RECORD

The extracted folder name and location without a personal username.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

You are no longer browsing inside the ZIP.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Navigate up one level, run Extract All again and choose a new folder.

STOP CONDITION

00_START_HERE or 02_PROJECTS is missing after extraction.

CONTINUE WITH

Step 3 — verify the package.

3. Verify package identity

Windows: VERIFY_PACKAGE.cmd
macOS/Linux: ./VERIFY_PACKAGE.sh

WHERE YOU ARE

The extracted package root.

WHAT TO FIND

VERIFY_PACKAGE.cmd on Windows or VERIFY_PACKAGE.sh on macOS/Linux.

EXACT ACTION

Run the platform launcher once. On macOS/Linux, allow execution only if your system requires it and you understand the local file.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

PASS_PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_EXACT_SET and a 64-character PACKAGE_ID.

WHAT TO RECORD

The complete verdict and PACKAGE_ID.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

There are no missing, extra, modified immutable or symlink entries.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Re-extract a clean copy. Do not repair a damaged package by guessing.

STOP CONDITION

Any integrity warning or ID mismatch remains.

CONTINUE WITH

Step 4 — check the environment.

4. Check Node.js and npm

Windows: CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.cmd
macOS/Linux: ./CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.sh

WHERE YOU ARE

The extracted package root terminal.

WHAT TO FIND

CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.cmd or CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.sh.

EXACT ACTION

Run the checker. It does not download or install anything.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

Either PASS_EXACT_RUNTIME for Node v24.21.0 and npm 11.19.0 or an explicit STOP mismatch with actual versions.

WHAT TO RECORD

Actual Node/npm versions and the checker verdict.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

You report a mismatch honestly and do not relabel it as a PASS.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Use the offline route or an authorised exact-runtime environment.

STOP CONDITION

A tool is missing, the checker hangs or the version output is ambiguous.

CONTINUE WITH

WHAT TO FIND

EXACT ACTION

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

The Explorer top level contains 00_START_HERE, 02_PROJECTS and 90_AUDIT.

WHAT TO RECORD

The folder name shown at the top of Explorer.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

The Explorer shows only src, tests or a ZIP viewer.

Step 6 — open the integrated terminal.

6. Open the integrated terminal at the root

WHERE YOU ARE

VS Code with the correct package root open.

WHAT TO FIND

Terminal > New Terminal.

EXACT ACTION

Open one terminal and read its current path before typing a command.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

WHAT TO RECORD

The final neutral folder segment, not your full personal path.

Step 7 — preserve the prediction.

7. Preserve the Ada prediction before execution

WHERE YOU ARE

The guide, P01 fixture and your blank form.

WHAT TO FIND

02_PROJECTS/P01/student/data/tasks.json and P01/spec.md.

EXACT ACTION

Without running the CLI, predict selected IDs and order, projected fields, trimmed titles, count, totalEstimate and owners for owner Ada with minimum estimate 3.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

A concrete, falsifiable prediction.

WHAT TO RECORD

Form field “Prediction before execution”, including a timestamp or sequence marker.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

The prediction existed before any output was viewed.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Close any output, read the fixture and write a fresh prediction marked as late if necessary.

STOP CONDITION

You have already seen the result and would present the prediction as prior.

CONTINUE WITH

Step 8 — run the initial state.

8. Run and classify the exact initial state

Windows: VERIFY_INITIAL_STATE.cmd
macOS/Linux: ./VERIFY_INITIAL_STATE.sh

WHERE YOU ARE

The package root terminal before editing.

WHAT TO FIND

VERIFY_INITIAL_STATE.

EXACT ACTION

Run once and inspect P01, P02 and P03 classifications.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

P01 baseline 2 pass, objective exactly 3 assertion failures, regression 2 pass; project-specific P02/P03 patterns also match.

WHAT TO RECORD

TAP summaries, actual runtime and any blocker.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

No timeout, crash, parse error, missing command, wrong test identity or unexpected stderr occurred.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Re-extract and rerun. Do not weaken a test or call infrastructure failure expected.

STOP CONDITION

Any failure category differs from the documented bounded assertions.

CONTINUE WITH

WHERE YOU ARE

VS Code Explorer under 02_PROJECTS/P01/student.

WHAT TO FIND

src/transform-tasks.js.

EXACT ACTION

Open that file. Read tests, fixture, CLI and spec without editing them.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

The TODO implementation and the comments describing the defensive transformation.

WHAT TO RECORD

The exact editable path.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

You can state which neighbouring files are read-only.

Step 10 — implement validation.

10. Validate own fields and exact types before selection

WHERE YOU ARE

transform-tasks.js and the P01 specification.

WHAT TO FIND

Required fields id, title, owner, status and estimate.

EXACT ACTION

Validate the input array, direct ownership and exact types before any filter. Reject non-finite estimates.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

Inherited owner and string estimate witnesses throw the specified TypeError.

WHAT TO RECORD

Witness input, output/error and relevant contract clause.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

Invalid records cannot disappear through a later filter.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Use the observer and compare Object.hasOwn with inherited lookup.

STOP CONDITION

A string is coerced or an inherited field is accepted.

CONTINUE WITH

Step 11 — separate selection and projection.

11. Separate selection from projection

WHERE YOU ARE

The same editable file.

WHAT TO FIND

The selection predicate and a later map to fresh records.

EXACT ACTION

Select open tasks with the owner/minimum threshold, then project id, trimmed title, owner and estimate into new objects.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

Selected population and projected shape can be explained separately.

WHAT TO RECORD

A short stage table and one-file diff summary.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

No input record is reused as output and status is not leaked into the projection.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Use a two-record witness and inspect identity, not only deep equality.

STOP CONDITION

The output is correct only because caller-owned records were changed.

CONTINUE WITH

Step 12 — deterministic order and summary.

12. Order deterministically and summarise the selected population

WHERE YOU ARE

transform-tasks.js after projection.

WHAT TO FIND

Estimate-descending order, id-ascending tie break and summary fields.

EXACT ACTION

Sort the fresh projected records and derive count, totalEstimate and sorted unique owners from the selected population.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

Ada/minimum-3 produces T-2 then T-3, count 2, total 8 and owners [Ada].

WHAT TO RECORD

Manual reconciliation between fixture, output and prediction.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

The summary uses the same selected population and tie break.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Inspect each stage independently rather than patching the final JSON.

STOP CONDITION

A different population is summarised or an in-place sort mutates input.

CONTINUE WITH

macOS/Linux: ./START_P01.sh --owner Ada --minimum-estimate 3

WHAT TO FIND

Step 14 — run ownership witnesses.

14. Run non-mutation and identity witnesses

node 02_PROJECTS/tools/observe.mjs P01

WHERE YOU ARE

Package root terminal and form.

WHAT TO FIND

02_PROJECTS/tools/observe.mjs P01.

macOS/Linux: ./TEST_P01.sh

Step 16 — bounded Gemini audit.

16. Audit one bounded Gemini claim

S03 bounded review. Do not implement the assessed module and do not rewrite tests, fixtures, CLI files, package metadata or dependencies.

My preserved prediction is: [ONE FALSIFIABLE CLAIM].
Synthetic input or witness: [SMALL INPUT].
Relevant contract clause: [ONE CLAUSE].
Actual observation so far: [OUTPUT, ERROR OR NOT YET RUN].

Review only this claim. Distinguish own-property lookup, exact types, input mutation, output-array identity and output-record identity where relevant. Propose one small independent witness rather than the finished function. State one limitation.

I will execute the witness independently and record ACCEPTED, REJECTED, PARTIALLY ACCEPTED or UNKNOWN. Your explanation is not test evidence.

WHERE YOU ARE

A new browser tab and the privacy-checked prompt file.

WHAT TO FIND

Gemini Web, a new chat and the Copy button in this guide.

EXACT ACTION

Send one bounded claim once, wait for the complete response, extract one claim and run an independent witness.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE

A four-state verdict, correction and explicit limitation.

WHAT TO RECORD

Interaction state, prompt, claim, witness, result, verdict, correction and limit.

DO NOT CONTINUE UNLESS

No sensitive data was sent and the model answer is not the sole evidence.

IF YOU DO NOT SEE THIS

Use SYNTHETIC PRACTICE — NOT GEMINI when offline and keep the actual-interaction state pending.

STOP CONDITION

The route would expose private data or you cannot distinguish claim from evidence.

CONTINUE WITH

Glossary

Own property
A field stored directly on an object.
Coercion
A type conversion that may hide invalid input.
Projection
A new record shape built from selected fields.
Mutation
An in-place change to caller-owned data.
Aliasing
Two references pointing to the same object.
TAP
The deterministic Node test output used by the gate.
Verdict
ACCEPTED, REJECTED, PARTIALLY ACCEPTED or UNKNOWN after independent checking.
